settings.label: Encrypted DNS
settings.help: Hides the websites you look up from your internet provider.

settings.label: DNS provider
settings.help: Quad9 and Mullvad keep no logs. AdGuard also blocks ads. Cloudflare is the fastest.

settings.label: Strict encrypted DNS
settings.help: Never fall back to unencrypted DNS. Safer, but some networks (hotels, schools) will stop working.

settings.label: Online check
settings.help: Lets the system ping an outside server to detect Wi-Fi login pages.

settings.label: Random Wi-Fi address while scanning
settings.help: Stops nearby Wi-Fi networks from tracking this PC.

settings.label: Tailscale
settings.help: Private network between your phone, laptops and this PC.

settings.label: Trust my Tailscale devices
settings.help: Lets your own devices reach Sunshine, RustDesk and Ollama. Everything else stays blocked.

settings.label: Ollama (local models)
settings.help: Runs AI models on your GPU.

settings.label: Allow my other devices to use Ollama
settings.help: Other devices can reach it through Tailscale only, because the firewall blocks everything else.

settings.label: Unload idle model after (minutes)
settings.help: Lower frees VRAM for games sooner. 0 unloads right away.

settings.label: Models loaded at once
settings.help: With 12 GB VRAM, 1 is safest for big models.

settings.label: Model storage folder
settings.help: Point this at a bigger drive if models fill up your disk, for example /var/mnt/games/models.

settings.label: Limit for AI model storage
settings.help: Keeps part of the disk with the model folder free for games, apps and files. Block refuses downloads that do not fit, and stops a download that goes over by restarting Ollama. Warn only tells you. Off has no limit.

settings.label: Space kept for games, apps and files
settings.help: Auto keeps 30% of the disk, at least 128 GB and at most 600 GB (a 1 TB disk keeps 300 GB). Percent and GB use the values below. AI models may use the rest.

settings.label: Space kept for games, apps and files (% of the disk)
settings.help: Used when the setting above is Percent.

settings.label: Space kept for games, apps and files (GB)
settings.help: Used when the setting above is GB.

settings.label: Most space AI models may use (GB)
settings.help: 0 means the whole disk minus the space kept for games, apps and files.

settings.label: Always keep free for system updates (GB)
settings.help: AI downloads stop before free space on that disk drops below this, whatever the other limits say.

settings.label: Agent CPU priority
settings.help: 100 is normal. Lower lets games and the desktop win when the CPU is busy.

settings.label: Slow agents down above (% of RAM)
settings.help: Soft limit. Agents slow down instead of crashing. A percentage, so it adjusts if you add or remove RAM.

settings.label: Hard memory cap (% of RAM)
settings.help: Agents can never use more than this share of your RAM.

settings.label: Health checks
settings.help: Checks services, disks, GPU and memory in the background.

settings.label: Warn when a disk is fuller than (%)
Warn when free RAM is below (GB)
Disk health (SMART)
settings.help: Warns before a drive fails.

settings.label: Gaming: agent RAM soft limit (% of RAM)
Gaming: AI while you play
settings.help: Wait pauses local AI models (Ollama) while a game runs and starts them again when it closes. CPU keeps them running on the processor only, so the graphics card stays free for the game (much slower). No limit changes nothing. Models from cloud providers (like OpenAI) are not affected.

settings.label: Agents: agent RAM soft limit (% of RAM)
Creative: agent RAM soft limit (% of RAM)
Quiet: agent RAM soft limit (% of RAM)
Laptop: switch mode on charger
settings.help: When you unplug the charger, switch to the battery mode below; when you plug it in, to the charger mode.

settings.label: Reinstall default apps on boot
settings.help: Turn off to remove any preinstalled app for good.

settings.label: Unlock the disk with a USB key
settings.help: Set it up once with: sudo forge-usbkey setup. Your password always works too.

settings.label: USB drive name
settings.help: The drive name of your key USB. Letters, numbers, - and _ only, up to 11 characters.

settings.label: Bluetooth
settings.help: Headphones, controllers, mice, phones. Turn off to save power or for privacy.

settings.label: Printing
settings.help: Lets you add and use printers.

settings.label: Mobile data (4G/5G modems)
settings.help: For laptops with a SIM card or a USB modem.

settings.label: Location services
settings.help: Lets apps ask for your location (each app still asks first). Off blocks location for everything.

settings.label: Set time zone automatically
settings.help: Updates the time zone when you travel, using KDE's own location-by-IP service. Your IP address is sent to KDE.

settings.label: Precise location from nearby Wi-Fi
settings.help: Much more accurate (street level instead of city level) by sending nearby Wi-Fi network IDs to beaconDB, an open, privacy-focused service.

settings.label: Run scheduled agents
settings.help: Agents with a repeat interval run on their own. Off means agents only run when you start them.

settings.label: Agents running at once
settings.help: Extra runs wait in a queue. Local models share one GPU, so 1 or 2 is best.

settings.label: Forge Core API
settings.help: Local API for settings, monitoring and AI models. Only this PC can reach it.

settings.label: API port
settings.help: The API listens on 127.0.0.1 at this port. Docs at http://127.0.0.1:47900/docs

settings.label: Record system stats every (seconds)
settings.help: Lower gives more detail in graphs, higher uses a little less power. History is kept for 90 days.

settings.label: Wait for the USB key (seconds)
settings.help: How long boot waits for the USB before asking for your password.

settings.label: Virtual machines (KVM)
settings.help: Sets up what Bazzite's "ujust setup-virtualization" does: virt-manager, libvirt and two kernel options. Downloads virt-manager from Flathub and needs a restart. Administrators (wheel group) can then manage VMs. Turning it off only removes what Forge set up.

settings.label: VM memory cap (% of RAM)
settings.help: All VMs together can never use more than this share of your RAM. A VM that goes over is stopped.

settings.label: VM CPU priority
settings.help: 100 is normal. Lower lets games and the desktop win when the CPU is busy.

settings.label: Shared drive with Windows
settings.help: Opens the drive or partition you share with Windows when you log in or plug it in. It must be exFAT or NTFS. Turn off Fast Startup in Windows first.

settings.label: Shared drive name
settings.help: The drive name you gave it in Windows. Letters, numbers, - and _ only, up to 32 characters. Upper or lower case does not matter.

settings.label: Shared folder in your home
settings.help: Adds a Shared link in your home folder that opens the shared drive. A folder or file you already have named Shared is never replaced.

settings.label: Share settings with my other PCs
settings.help: Puts this PC's shareable settings in the sync folder below and tells you when another PC's are newer. Nothing changes until you apply them with forge-settings-sync apply. No cloud account.

settings.label: Sync folder
settings.help: A folder every PC can reach: a shared drive, a USB stick or a synced folder. Must be inside your home folder, /run/media or /mnt, for example /run/media/alex/FORGESYNC.

settings.label: Automatic backups
settings.help: Backs up your home folder to the backup drive by itself, and when you plug the drive in. Run forge-backup init once first. You can always run forge-backup run by hand.

settings.label: Backup drive name
settings.help: The drive name (label) of your USB or second drive. Up to 11 letters, numbers, _ or -.

settings.label: Back up every (hours)
settings.help: How old the last backup may get before a new one starts. Forge checks every hour and when the drive is plugged in.

settings.label: Keep daily backups
settings.help: How many days keep their newest backup. Older ones are removed after each good backup.

settings.label: Keep weekly backups
settings.help: How many weeks keep their newest backup.

settings.label: Keep monthly backups
settings.help: How many months keep their newest backup.

settings.label: Skip big files you can download again
settings.help: Skips Steam games (saves are kept), Ollama models, caches, the Trash, Flatpak app caches and virtual machine disks.

settings.label: Notify me about system updates
settings.help: Tells you once when an update is ready (restart to use it), when an update failed, and when the PC started an older version.

settings.label: Update channel
settings.help: Stable gets tested updates. Testing gets new changes first and can break. Switching asks you to confirm, downloads the other version (its signature is checked) and starts it after the next restart. To go back, choose Stable again and restart.

settings.label: Go back automatically if an update fails to start
settings.help: Only on the first start of a new system version: if the login screen fails to start, or the NVIDIA driver does not load although it loaded on the last good start, the PC restarts and tries again, and after 3 failed starts goes back to the previous version. Optional Forge services and a slow or USB key disk unlock never count. Off keeps a new version even when these checks fail.

settings.label: Game overlay (MangoHud)
settings.help: Minimal is an FPS counter. Full adds frame times, CPU and GPU load and temperature, VRAM and RAM. It shows only in games you start with MangoHud (in Steam: Properties, Launch options: mangohud %command%), never in other apps. Right Shift+F12 shows or hides it in a game. Saved per user in ~/.config/MangoHud/MangoHud.conf; a MangoHud.conf you made yourself is never changed.

settings.label: Gaming mode while a game runs
settings.help: When a Steam game or Roblox (Sober) starts, Forge switches to gaming mode (see Performance modes: AI models unloaded, agents slowed down) and back to your mode about 15 seconds after it ends. If anything crashes, it switches back at the next check or login. A mode you pick during the game is kept.
